title: ?? vs ||: the zero bug
why_it_matters: || treats 0 and empty string as missing, which corrupts real data.
explanation: || falls back whenever the left side is falsy, including 0 and ''. ?? only falls back for null or undefined. If 0 or an empty string is a valid value, like a quantity, use ??.
try_it: Set qty to an empty string and compare both lines.
